== Description ==
It's the Hay Day Birthday Bake Off and vote for your favorite cake to win!

To celebrate Hay Day's 7th birthday we asked two amazing bakers, Laurie Shannon (https://www.youtube.com/theicingartist) and Yolanda Gampp (https://www.youtube.com/howtocakeit) to create their own unique Hay Day cakes.

Laurie's Cake: https://youtu.be/qKZ-WmedFuY
Yolanda's Cake: https://youtu.be/4SJSBGWefs0

You will now have the chance to choose the one you like the most by voting in our poll on our Youtube community page: https://www.youtube.com/user/haydayofficial/community

The winning cake will make it into the game as a special decoration to celebrate Hay Day's 7th birthday!! :) 

Go and vote now!
